headline: Explosions Echo Over Manama as IRGC Claims Precision Strike on US Radar in Bahrain
summary: Explosions were reported in Manama following a nationwide threat alert. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed a precision strike on a US radar in Bahrain.
why: Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, and Gulf security incidents affect oil shipping and regional risk premiums that global investors monitor.
